title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
desc: In Bareilly, free-spirited Bitti defies marriage pressures until her life changes when she meets Chirag and Pritam, sparking unexpected adventures and romance.

title: Bobby
desc: Raja, a wealthy businessman's son, falls head over heels for Bobby, a fisherman's daughter. But with their families against their love, will they fight for their happily ever after?

title: Andaz Apna Apna
desc: Amar and Prem are broke dreamers chasing the same rich heiress, Raveena, but their silly feud gets wildly out of hand after crossing paths with dangerous gangster Teja.

title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan
desc: Arjun and Pyare, two cops from the same station, are wrongly accused of multiple crimes. Their probe reveals the real offenders are their own lookalike impostors.

title: 102 Not Out
desc: Dattatraya, a lively 102-year-old, wants to break the world record for oldest person. He believes his son, Babulal, is too boring to help him achieve this goal.

title: Bulandi
desc: Dharamraj Thakur, a respected village leader, faces disgrace when his younger brother Arjun is falsely accused of raping a schoolteacher, shaking the village's trust and honor.

title: Don - The Chase Begins Again
desc: Vijay, a lookalike of crime lord Don, is recruited to uncover his secrets. When the officer guiding him dies, Vijay is trapped in a deadly maze, struggling to prove his true identity.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Bamfaad
desc: Nasir, a reckless politician's son, falls for Neelam, a rival's mistress. Their affair sparks a violent feud that spirals into bloodshed and political chaos.

title: Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein
desc: Maddy impersonates Rajeev, the man Reena is set to marry, in an attempt to win her love - but he's unprepared for the chaos that follows when the truth comes out.

title: Toilet: Ek Prem Katha
desc: Keshav marries Jaya and adores her, but their happiness falters when she protests the lack of a toilet at home. As tensions rise, he struggles to appease her with temporary fixes.

title: Baadshah
desc: Desperate for a major career breakthrough, private investigator Raj accepts a hostage recovery mission, only to stumble straight into the center of a massive political plot.

title: Bombay To Goa
desc: Mala, a young woman who witnesses a murder, flees on a Goa-bound bus. Along the way, she meets colourful travellers from different cultures and a spirited young man who refuses to leave her side.

title: Aaj Ka Arjun
desc: Bheema, exiled for defying a cruel landlord, must rally the very villagers who shunned him when his nephew Kanhaiya is kidnapped, sparking a tense rescue mission.

title: Love, Sex Aur Dhokha 2
desc: Three interconnected tales follow different people navigating the murky waters of human intimacy, sexual discovery, personal identity, and modern romance inside a hyper-connected, digital world.

title: Satyam Shivam Sundaram
desc: Rajeev marries Roopa, a beautiful singer, but he struggles to accept her when he discovers her disfigured face, causing emotional pain and conflict in their relationship.
